details: Bitcoin rebounded from below $80,000 to $82,500, nearing the $84,000 resistance level after an earlier dip. However, continued US spot Bitcoin ETF withdrawals and Brent crude oil prices above $110 a barrel are keeping inflation concerns in focus, creating potential headwinds for further price increases.
title: Bitcoin Recovers to $82.5K, But ETF Outflows & Oil Prices Pose Risks

details: Ethereum's price rose by 2.96% in the last 24 hours. Despite the price gain, sentiment in ETH derivatives has slightly turned negative over the past week, with the net taker volume indicating a tilt towards net selling. This shift in derivatives has historically been associated with bearish positioning.
title: Ethereum Up Nearly 3%, Derivatives Sentiment Turns Negative

details: XRP's price surged about 5% in the last 24 hours, reaching $1.36, marking its highest point in a week. This rebound coincides with a pause in ETF-related inflows, which may have reduced selling pressure and potentially signals renewed investor interest in the asset.
title: XRP Jumps 5% to Weekly High Amid Stalled ETF Inflows

details: Solana's Alpenglow upgrade has successfully launched on its mainnet, with the objective of achieving 99% faster transaction finality. The SOL token's price experienced an increase of almost 3% in the 24 hours leading up to the implementation of this significant technical upgrade.
title: Solana's Alpenglow Launches on Mainnet, Targets Faster Finality

details: Celestia (TIA) saw a 3.38% price surge after activating its Fibre upgrade. This enhancement allows rollups to directly upload large data blobs to validators, significantly improving Celestia's data availability capabilities, and driving a repricing of the asset.
title: Celestia (TIA) Jumps 3.38% Following Fibre Upgrade Activation

details: The STABLE token experienced an 8.4% increase in price after Coinbase added it to its asset-listing roadmap. This signals a potential future listing on the major exchange, which typically leads to improved liquidity and investor interest for the token.
title: STABLE Token Rises 8.4% After Coinbase Roadmap Addition

details: Monero (XMR) rose 4% to $622, breaking through key resistance around $600. This price rally was amplified by favorable derivatives flows and a supportive narrative surrounding the growing interest in privacy coins.
title: Monero (XMR) Surges 4% on Breakout and Privacy Narrative
